name: Linq
description: Messaging API that gives AI agents phone lines sending native iMessage, RCS and SMS, with group chats, reactions, typing indicators and webhooks. For agent and assistant builders.

skills.name: Send and Receive iMessages
skills.description: Send and receive native iMessage, RCS and SMS messages with attachments, voice memos and rich link previews over REST.

skills.name: Manage Group Chats
skills.description: Create and manage group conversations, show typing indicators, share contact cards and react to messages.

skills.name: Check iMessage Capability
skills.description: Probe whether a phone number or handle can receive iMessage or RCS before sending, and check line reputation.

skills.name: Receive Message Webhooks
skills.description: Get webhook events for inbound messages, reactions, typing and delivery status on your Linq phone numbers.
